"use client" import { RocketIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Toaster, createToastManager } from "@workspace/ui/components/toast" const notify = createToastManager() const stages = [ { title: "Building", description: "Installing dependencies..." }, { title: "Deploying", description: "Uploading to edge network..." }, ] export default function DeploymentPipelineToast() { function deploy() { const id = notify.add({ type: "loading", ...stages[0], timeout: 0 }) setTimeout(() => notify.update(id, stages[1]!), 1500) setTimeout( () => notify.update(id, { type: "success", title: "Live on production", description: "acme-web deployed in 42s", timeout: 5000, actionProps: { children: "Visit" }, }), 3000 ) } return (
